468:t_024:1.en:
$$凱$$
「That female android is sending energy to $$マジンガー$$!」

468:t_024:2.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Dr. $$剣造$$ built the ability to control Photon Power into my $$Ｑちゃん$$!」

468:t_024:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It's useless! Adding a little power of light now will never overcome my darkness!」

468:t_024:5.en:
$n
「Wake up, $$甲児$$! Where there is hope, light is born!!」

468:t_025:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Ghh... $$マジンガー$$...! Together... with me...」

468:t_025:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「This is bad! Before he revives...!」

468:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry about me, $n! Just protect that cutie, no matter what!」

468:t_026:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Why, $$竜馬$$?! Why are you going so far to protect $$甲児$$?!」

468:t_026:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$ sees himself in $$甲児$$.」

468:t_026:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$甲児$$'s like this guy was as a kid. Well, he's gotten a little older and more twisted now.」

468:t_026:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... I let you see something pretty damn embarrassing.」

468:t_026:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey, $$甲児$$! After making me go this far, you're still half asleep?!」

468:t_026:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If you don't wake up right now, you're starting your training over from scratch!!」

468:t_027:1.en:
$$剣造$$
「$$甲児$$ has now... become one with Photon Power...」

468:t_028:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Look, Big Sis! Even the terrain has changed!」

468:t_028:4.en:
$$さやか$$
「This is...! The $$科学要塞研究所$$, before $$ミケーネ$$ came!」

468:t_028:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is this the power of Photon Power...?!」

468:t_028:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can feel strength welling up from deep inside me...!」

468:t_029:0.en:
$$剣造$$
「Photon Power... It is the force that seeks to exist...」

468:t_029:1.en:
$$剣造$$
「That power can even create something out of nothing.」

468:t_029:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Impossible...! That's impossible! Lord $$ハーデス$$, please answer me! Lord $$ハーデス$$!!」

468:t_029:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Calling him won't help, $$ガラダブラ$$! $$ハーデス$$ vanished before my light!」

468:t_029:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Damn you, Demon God of Light!! Then I shall avenge Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

468:t_029:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「If Photon Power can create something out of nothing...!」

468:t_029:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll bring back that power Professor $$弓$$ and the others prepared for me and $$マジンガー$$, right here and now!!」

468:t_029:9.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you planning to do?!」

468:t_030:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Did $$マジンガー$$ create that Rocket Punch?!」

468:t_031:0.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「You did it, $$甲児$$.」

468:t_031:2.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「Now that you've awakened to the true light, I have nothing more to tell you.」

468:t_031:3.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「I shall go to sleep. From here on, you must guide $$マジンガー$$.」

468:t_031:4.en:
$$オジイちゃん$$
「Whether you make it a god or a devil... It's all up to you.」

468:t_031:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even I'm worn out. I'll back you up from here on.」

468:t_032:1.en:
$$クロス$$
「Quit dragging your feet and join up with $n.」

468:t_032:5.en:
$$お菊$$
「Come on, boys. We'll give you a hand.」

468:t_032:6.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Now that we're here, you don't have anything to fear.」

468:t_032:8.en:
$$ボス$$
「Y-Yeah! All right, I'll do it!!」

468:t_033:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「Let's do this, $n! Now that $$甲児$$'s shown what he's made of, I gotta follow his lead!」

468:t_035:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Coming back from hell sure gives you guts.」

468:t_035:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We'll go on the offensive with $$マジンガー$$ at the center. Our target is the hero $$ガラダブラ$$.」

468:t_035:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ガラダブラ$$! This time, I'll settle things for good!」

468:t_035:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I will not retreat! For Lord $$ハーデス$$' sake too!!」

468:t_035:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show you the light that drove away $$ハーデス$$!!」

468:t_036:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「You sure don't know when to give up!」

468:t_036:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then I'll finish you off!」

468:t_036:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「The powers of darkness are gathering... Soon, my body will be restored as well.」
